meta.title: Sankalp Yerawar | Backend Engineer
meta.description: Portfolio of Sankalp Yerawar - Senior Backend Engineer specializing in distributed systems, cloud architectures, and data streaming.

profile.name: SANKALP YERAWAR
profile.subtitle: Backend Development & Distributed Systems Architect
summary: 7+ years in backend development, distributed systems, and cloud architectures across automotive, healthcare, and manufacturing.

Built real-time streaming, HIPAA-compliant apps, and automated supply chain systems. Expertise in microservices, high-scale data processing, and cloud-native applications. Designed large-scale pipelines with Kafka, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Collaborated with clients to drive business decisions and improve product design. Passionate about clean architecture, DDD, TDD, and system optimization.

experience.title: Solution Consultant
details: Working on a connected vehicle project for a vehicle manufacturer in Java. Managing real-time streaming data (Telemetry, CAN, event data) using Kafka and Kafka Streams.
Handling large-scale data storage with Cassandra, Redis, and PostgreSQL, ensuring high availability and performance.
Collaborating with clients to design and improve connected vehicle solutions, contributing to business decisions that enhance product development.
Developed an MES application using Kotlin and Spring Boot to optimize manufacturing workflows.
Built a replenishment application to automate supply chain processes and reduce manual inefficiencies in 15 days.
Managing service deployments on Kubernetes hosted on AWS, utilizing Jenkins, Vault, and Terraform for CI/CD and infrastructure automation.
Implemented monitoring and observability with Prometheus and Grafana to optimize system performance.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer - 2
details: Developed HIPAA-compliant cloud-based applications to streamline administrative services for healthcare entities.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design distributed systems using Serverless computing, AWS Lambda, and event-driven architecture.
Built REST APIs with a domain-driven design approach in Kotlin using the Micronaut framework. Utilized Kotest for testing and SonarCloud/Detekt for static code analysis.
Managed data storage and retrieval using Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.
Developed dynamic browser applications using React.
Worked on addressing technical debt to enhance the performance and maintainability of existing codebases.

experience.title: Software Engineer
details: Designed and implemented a Command Prediction microservice in C# using advanced data structures and prediction algorithms.
Applied MVC architecture principles, including Dependency Injection, Singleton pattern, Repository pattern, and Factory pattern.
Developed a dashboard application using GraphQL and Python for enhanced data visualization.
Integrated multi-database support (Oracle, MSSQL, PostgreSQL).
Deployed microservices using Docker and Swarm.
Authored a white paper on Object-Based APIs using GraphQL and OData.
Prototyped a multi-API support framework using gRPC and Protocol Buffers.
